title: The Decoy Dilemma in Online Medical Information Evaluation: A Comparative Study of Credibility Assessments by LLM and Human Judges

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing credibility assessment ratings of target medical information articles by LLMs and human judges in a control group (no decoy) versus a treatment group (with an intentionally crafted inferior decoy article) to measure if the decoy's presence artificially inflates the target's perceived credibility.
